# Repair brief

A behavioural check of this web app failed. Fix the app so the behaviour below works for any data, not only the example values. (Brief brief-142a6e6f-2d6f-4608-9f0a-29eea662cc73.)

## What a user does

1. Open the page.
2. Add a new book with title "GP Beta 1b7e12-run-0", author "Ada Okafor", 123 pages, not read yet, and save it.
3. Add a new book with title "GP Alpha 1b7e12-run-0", author "Ada Okafor", 123 pages, not read yet, and save it.
4. Remove the book titled "GP Alpha 1b7e12-run-0".

## What went wrong

- Requirement: After "Remove the book titled "GP Alpha 1b7e12-run-0".", the title of every book currently shown (titles only, not authors or other fields), separated by |, or 'none' should include "GP Beta 1b7e12-run-0".
- Checked after step: Remove the book titled "GP Alpha 1b7e12-run-0".
- Expected: GP Beta 1b7e12-run-0
- Observed: none
- Screenshot of the page after that step: <tmp>\optimus-repair-20261122205046-1b7e12\brief\attempt-1-L3.jpg

## Rules

- App folder: <tmp>\optimus-repair-20261122205046-1b7e12\app
- Allowed scope: Only the files of this app folder. Do not create or edit anything outside it.
- Fix the general behaviour. Do not special-case the example titles or detect that a test is running.
- Keep every other behaviour of the app working. The full set of behavioural checks runs again after your change.

attempts.requirement: After "Remove the book titled "GP Alpha 1b7e12-run-0".", the title of every book currently shown (titles only, not authors or other fields), separated by |, or 'none' should include "GP Beta 1b7e12-run-0".

agent.finalMessage:
I fixed the Remove button. It was deleting the wrong book: whichever Remove button you clicked, the code took out the first card in the list and the first book in saved storage.

The fix is in `app.js:38-50`. Each Remove button now deletes its own card, and its own book from saved storage. The book is found by the object itself, not by its title, so two books with the same title don't get mixed up. After a removal, focus still moves to the next card's Remove button, or to the title field if no books are left.

I haven't run the app or any tests, as the brief asked. The re-check should show "GP Beta 1b7e12-run-0" still listed after removing "GP Alpha 1b7e12-run-0".

One thing I couldn't fully explain: the check saw "none" after the removal. The old bug should have left one book on screen, not zero. My fix addresses the bug I found in the code, but if the re-check still shows "none", the cause is something else.

agent.finalMessage:
I fixed it: books you add should now still be there after you reload the page. I haven't run it in a browser, as the brief said, so the independent re-check will confirm it.

**Cause:** The app read the saved list from the browser's local storage when the page opened, but nothing ever wrote to it. New books existed only on the open page, so a reload brought back an empty list.

**Fix (all in `app.js`):**
- **New save step:** a `saveBooks()` function writes the current list to local storage. It runs after you add a book, after you toggle read, and after you remove a book, so all three changes now survive a reload.
- **Safer loading:** a `loadBooks()` function now reads the saved list. If the stored data is broken or isn't a list, the app starts empty instead of failing to load.
- **Safer removal:** Remove now only deletes the book if it's actually in the list. Before, if it wasn't found, the code would have deleted the last book instead.

Nothing else about how the app behaves has changed, and the fix doesn't depend on any particular title or data.

agent.finalMessage:
I fixed it: books you add now stay on the page after a reload. I haven't run the app or any tests, as the brief asked; it will be re-checked independently.

**Cause:** When you added a book, the app put it in its in-memory list and drew its card, but never saved it to the browser's local storage. Toggling and removing books already saved, but adding didn't. So after a reload the app read the stored list, found nothing there, and showed "No books yet."

**Fix:** In `app.js`, the add-book form handler now calls `saveBooks()` right after adding the book to the list (`app.js:62`). This works for any book, not just the example values, and nothing else in the app changed.
